name: omniscient/omnitrade
description: Omnitrade: one contract for payment providers and commerce platforms - purchase, authorize, capture, refund, webhooks, platform orders - and its Symfony bundle (Omnibus's sibling for trade).

suggest.phpunit/phpunit: In a provider's tests: Omnitrade\Testing\GatewayContractTests, the family's conformance suite (with symfony/http-client's MockHttpClient)
suggest.omnitrade/stripe: Stripe: cards and wallets through Checkout, refunds, webhooks
suggest.omnitrade/shopify: Shopify: draft orders paid on its invoice page, orders, webhooks
suggest.omnitrade/woocommerce: WooCommerce: orders and their payment state over the REST API
suggest.omnitrade/web: Any product page, read from its own markup; affiliate links by host
suggest.omnitrade/amazon: Amazon: products through the Creators API, affiliate links with the partner tag
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnitrade\Bridge\Symfony\OmnitradeBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnitrade\Bridge\Symfony\OmnitradeBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnitrade\Bridge\Symfony\OmnitradeBundle itself
